name: one-day-hostels
description: One Day Hostels - hostel, PG and accommodation booking platform for Visakhapatnam

scripts.dev: concurrently -n emulators,web -c yellow,green "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-one-day-hostels --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.emulators:resume: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-one-day-hostels --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test:unit -w functions
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod
